Hi Claire,

Thanks again for the quick intro. To make the compliance intake efficient for both teams, would Bankly be open to a focused 45-minute session that covers: SOC 2 scoping questions, DPA review items, and a short pen-test readiness checklist? Our aim is to avoid a multi-hour workshop — just enough to lock decisions and next steps.

Proposed compact slots (all CEST):
- Tue 20 Jul, 10:00–10:45 CEST
- Wed 21 Jul, 14:00–14:45 CEST
- Thu 22 Jul, 08:30–09:15 CEST

If none of those work, please suggest two alternatives and we will try to match.

For context I'm looping in Priyom (security intake lead) and Olga (ops lead) so they can bring the relevant artifacts. We'll attach a short SOC2/DPA ask worksheet beforehand (one spreadsheet) and an ops network diagram.

Thanks —
Jonas

Hi Jonas —

Thanks for the options. The team prefers Wed 21 Jul 14:00–14:45 CEST; that works well for our London and Paris folks. Can you confirm who will attend from Redwood and whether this call will include a pen-test scope discussion or just readiness/evidence mapping?

Two quick asks from our side before the call:
- Can you send the short SOC2 ask worksheet you mentioned (so we can pre-populate answers)?
- Are there any high-level network diagrams or flow charts we should review ahead of time?

We have one pen-test vendor question: will Redwood provide historical pen-test results or a vendor-facing scope summary during the intake? If not, should we treat the pen-test topic as a follow-up?

Regards,
Claire

Claire, Jonas —

Confirmed from our side: Wed 21 Jul 14:00–14:45 CEST is good for Ops and Platform. Attendees from Redwood: Jonas (solutions), Priyom (security intake lead), Olga (ops/infra). We'll keep the meeting strictly timeboxed to 45 minutes with this agenda: 1) scoping & success criteria (10m), 2) DPA questions & data flows (15m), 3) pen-test readiness (10m), 4) next steps and owner mapping (10m).

Quick answers to Claire's questions:
- I'll attach the SOC2 ask worksheet and a lightweight network diagram to the calendar invite (we'll also upload to the Drive link).
- Regarding pen-test history: Redwood is happy to summarize historical pen-test dates and the high-level remediation status in the call, but we will not share full raw reports over email. If Bankly's vendor needs the raw report, we can coordinate an NDA-backed transfer / redacted extract post-intake. For the meeting, we'll treat pen-test as "readiness + scope" and capture any vendor handoff actions as follow-ups.

Olga
